d: Donald Trump's political setback in the US midterm elections could create an uncomfortable situation for FIFA president Gianni Infantino. With the FIFA World Cup 2026 bringing the two men closer than ever, questions are emerging about Infantino's political connections, the scrutiny surrounding his relationship with Trump and the possibility of congressional investigations. Rupha Ramani examines whether changing political equations in Washington could complicate Infantino's bid for another term in the 2027 FIFA presidential election.
